captions.detailed: A handheld digital camcorder in a dark matte finish. The main body is a rectangular block with an upper raised section, a side-mounted flat LCD panel, and a rear mode dial. Extending from the front is a cylindrical lens assembly featuring a rotating focus/zoom ring. The LCD screen on the left side is designed to swing outward, and the lens ring rotates about the optical axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a handheld camcorder with a rectangular main body, a side-mounted flip-out LCD panel, and a multi-segmented cylindrical lens barrel. Include a rotating zoom ring on the lens and a mode dial on the top rear of the housing.
captions.factory: The code constructs the camcorder by defining a base body using box primitives, with a smaller box on top. It models the lens using nested cylinders of varying radii and lengths, including a hollowed-out cylinder for the lens opening. A thin box represents the side LCD panel, and a flat cylinder represents the top mode dial. These parts are assembled into a multi-link system with appropriate relative coordinate offsets.
